resources.string: Add domains such as github.com. Each domain inherits Browser · All rules, then can add its own hidden apps and ordering. Removing a domain also removes its dedicated rules and ordering.
Enter a valid host such as github.com.
Current ordering source: inherited from Browser · All

Without dedicated ordering, this domain inherits Browser · All directly. The first select, deselect, drag, or move operation creates dedicated ordering from the inherited order. Restoring inheritance follows future Browser · All changes again.
